facts.fact: Neela believes the household's weak hour is the last dark hour before first light, when the night wall pairs have stood longest, lanterns burn low and Raiu nods at the corridor torch. She knows Devan's early rising only from Janu and the pit lamps, never having seen it, since she is always out on the hill then. At first light she hears him abed again and is unsure. This corrects and replaces F075 (the day watch changes six clanks after dawn, F045).
The rampart above the warden's window has been empty two nights by the night of chapter 6, since Devan pulled the sentry in chapter 5. Neela notes it but no longer calls it luck.
Before each of her eleven completed contracts, Master Chathu sent Neela a tin of warm jaggery-sesame sweets 'for luck'. She learned around the fifth that a gift is the start of a bill.
